text.p: Shares of International Business Machines Corp fell to 128-1/2 in pre-opening trading on Friday from its Thursday close at 131-3/8, traders said.
IBM was downgraded earlier on a near-term basis to neutral from buy, according to a source at Merrill Lynch & Co. The stock was kept at long-term buy, the source said.
The move could take the Dow Industrials down a peg at the opening, since IBM is a component of the 30-stock index.
Ultrak Inc and Checkpoint Systems Inc were sharply lower in heavy pre-opening trading after the two companies terminated a merger agreement.
Ultrak fell from its Thursday Nasdaq closing price of 16-1/2 to as low as 10-3/4. Checkpoint slumped to 10-1/4.

Ultrak also said it expects first quarter earnings per share of $0.16 to $0.18, excluding a $0.03 a share expense. Wall Street had expected first quarter earnings of $0.21 a share, according to First Call.
Early winners were Telebras and FORE Systems Inc. Telebras American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose to 112-1/2 from their Thursday close on the New York Stock Exchange of 108-3/4.
Morgan Stanley said earlier it raised its 12-month target price on Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras to $145 from $115 per ADS.
FORE shares rose to 14. MCI Communications edged higher to 36-1/2 from their NYSE close at 36, traders said, and Bellwether Exploration Co inched higher to 8-7/16 from its close at 8-3/4.
